data.title: VoIP Number MFA Enrollment
data.description: Detects MFA enrollment using VoIP or virtual phone numbers instead of legitimate mobile carrier numbers. Attackers who have compromised an account often enroll a disposable VoIP number (Google Voice, TextNow, Twilio) as the MFA phone to maintain persistent access and intercept future OTP codes without relying on SIM swap persistence.
falsepositives: Legitimate users who use VoIP as their primary phone service
Business accounts that use virtual phone systems for operations
